title: T-KEIR Pipeline Output Document
description: JSON schema for a fully analyzed document produced by thot/tools/pipeline.py (e.g. *.pipeline.json). Fields are appended incrementally by pipeline tasks in execution order.

data_source.description: Origin of the document payload (for example converter-service or a loaded pipeline JSON).

source_doc_id.description: Stable document identifier, usually a file:// URI or logical source id used as parent_doc_id for chunks.

title.description: Document title extracted by the converter.

title-generated.description: True when the title was auto-generated by the keywords task because the converter left title empty.

content.description: Document body split into sections or pages. Each item is a plain-text block.

kg.description: Knowledge graph triples produced by syntax analysis and converter metadata tags.

error.description: True when the converter reported an error while building the document.

conversion-info.description: Converter metadata about input format, size, and optional OCR/image extraction.

tasks-info.description: Execution metadata appended by each pipeline task (one entry per completed task).

language-detection.description: Detected document language and confidence score.

resource-selection.description: Language-specific NLP resource paths selected for this document.

content_tokens.description: Tokenizer output for content: content block -> sentence -> token.

title_tokens.description: Tokenizer output for title with the same nesting as content_tokens.

title_morphosyntax.description: Morphosyntactic tags for title tokens (flat token index aligned with title_ner and title_deps).

content_morphosyntax.description: Morphosyntactic tags for content tokens (flat token index aligned with content_ner, content_deps, kg positions, and golden chunks).

title_ner.description: Named entities detected in the title.

content_ner.description: Named entities detected in the content.

title_deps.description: Universal Dependencies-style parse for title tokens.

content_deps.description: Universal Dependencies-style parse for content tokens.

keywords.description: Extracted keyphrases from title and content ranked by RAKE score.

golden_chunks.description: Semantically segmented content chunks enriched with entities, SVO triplets, context summaries, and synthetic questions.

document_ontology.description: RDF document ontology serialized as Turtle, SHACL validation status, repair metadata, and text coverage metrics.

chunk_questions_ready.description: True when synthetic questions were generated for all golden chunks.

title-token-count.description: Number of morphosyntax tokens in the title.

content-token-count.description: Number of morphosyntax tokens in the content.

token-count.description: Total number of morphosyntax tokens in title plus content.

source-file-size-bytes.description: Size in bytes of the original source file when available.

image-extraction.description: Top-level copy of OCR/image extraction settings and usage for the source document.

pipeline-timing.description: End-to-end pipeline runtime and per-task elapsed seconds.

KGTripleEntry.description: One side of a knowledge-graph triple (subject, property, or value).

content.description: Surface-form tokens for this triple side.

positions.description: Flat token indices in title_morphosyntax or content_morphosyntax.

label.description: Syntactic pattern label or named-entity label for this span.

label_content.description: Optional label content used by converter-generated tag triples.

lemma_content_single.description: Legacy single-string lemma representation when present.

class.description: Optional semantic class id from clustering.

KGTriple.description: Subject-property-value relation extracted from syntax or converter tags.

subject.description: Triple subject (for example an entity or tag name).

value.description: Triple object (entity, literal, or tag type).

field_type.description: Document field the triple was extracted from.

automatically_fill.description: True when the triple was inferred automatically by syntax rules.

confidence.description: Confidence score assigned to the triple when available.

weight.description: Optional ranking weight for the triple.

datatype.description: Resolved input format (pdf, docx, raw, email, etc.).

fallback-from.description: Original detected format when conversion fell back to raw text.

ImageExtraction.description: OCR/image extraction configuration and runtime statistics.

enabled.description: Whether OCR fallback is enabled in converter settings.

used.description: Whether OCR was actually invoked for this document.

TaskInfo.description: Provenance record for one executed pipeline task.

task-name.description: Pipeline task name (converter, tokenizer, morphosyntax, ner, syntax, keywords, chunking, ontology, chunk-questions).

task-version.description: Version string of the task implementation.

task-development-date.description: Development or release date of the task implementation.

hostname.description: Host name where the task ran.

host.description: Host IP address where the task ran.

os.description: Operating system details [platform, node, release, version, machine].

LanguageDetection.description: Language identification result used to select NLP resources.

language.description: ISO-like language code (for example en, fr).

ResourceSelection.description: Resolved resource bundle for NLP processing.

spacy-language.description: spaCy model language code in use.

resources-base-path.description: Base path to tokenizer/NLP resources for the selected language.

available-languages.description: Languages available in the current resource installation.

MWEInfo.description: Multi-word expression metadata attached to a token.

is-compound.description: True when the token belongs to a detected compound/MWE.

TokenEntry.description: One tokenizer token with sentence boundary and optional MWE metadata.

start_sentence.description: True when this token starts a sentence.

MorphoSyntaxToken.description: Morphosyntactic annotation for one flat token index.

is_oov.description: True when the token is out-of-vocabulary for the morphosyntax tagger.

is_sent_start.description: True when this token starts a sentence.

position.description: Optional explicit flat token index, mainly used during keyword extraction.

NERSpan.description: Named entity span over flat morphosyntax token indices.

label.description: Entity type label (person, organization, date, location, etc.).

DependencyToken.description: Dependency parse node for one token.

head.description: Index of the syntactic head token.

dep.description: Dependency relation label (ROOT, nsubj, dobj, etc.).

lefts.description: Indices of dependent tokens to the left.

rights.description: Indices of dependent tokens to the right.

score.description: RAKE ranking score for the keyphrase.

span.description: Token span in title_morphosyntax or content_morphosyntax.

GoldenChunkMetadata.description: Semantic enrichment attached to a golden chunk.

token_start.description: Inclusive flat content token index where the chunk starts.

token_end.description: Exclusive flat content token index where the chunk ends.

sentence_start.description: Inclusive sentence index inside the chunk window.

sentence_end.description: Exclusive sentence index inside the chunk window.

primary_entities.description: Named entities in the chunk grouped by NER label.

svo_triplets.description: Subject-verb-object triples as [subject, verb, object] string arrays.

implicit_subjects.description: Resolved anaphora or implicit subject references in the chunk.

context_summary_before.description: Short summary of the previous chunk used as retrieval context.

context_summary_after.description: Short summary of the next chunk used as retrieval context.

SyntheticQuestion.description: Template-generated question for chunk-level QA or vector retrieval.

question_type.description: Template family used to generate the question.

GoldenChunk.description: One semantically coherent chunk ready for indexing or QA.

chunk_id.description: Stable chunk identifier derived from parent document and chunk text.

parent_doc_id.description: Source document identifier this chunk belongs to.

text_raw.description: Raw chunk text without context padding.

search_vector_payload.description: Chunk text enriched with optional [CONTEXT_BEFORE] and [CONTEXT_AFTER] summaries for embedding or retrieval.

synthetic_questions.description: Generated questions for this chunk (present after chunk-questions task).

OntologyIncoherence.description: One SHACL validation issue or auto-repair outcome.

focus_node.description: RDF focus node URI associated with the violation.

status.description: Whether the issue remains or was repaired by the self-healing loop.

DocumentOntology.description: SHACL-validated RDF ontology built from SVO triples, NER, keywords, dependencies, and golden chunks.

rdf_graph_serialized.description: Document RDF graph serialized in Turtle format.

shacl_status.description: Outcome of SHACL validation after optional rule-based self-healing.

correction_attempts.description: Number of ontology repair attempts performed.

text_coverage_percent.description: Percentage of document characters represented in the ontology (KG, NER, keywords, dependencies, chunks, tags).

covered_tokens.description: Number of morphosyntax tokens covered by ontology sources.

total_tokens.description: Total morphosyntax tokens in title and content.

covered_characters.description: Number of characters covered by ontology sources.

total_characters.description: Total characters in title and content morphosyntax.

PipelineTiming.description: Pipeline runtime metrics collected during execution.

elapsed-seconds.description: Total wall-clock runtime of the pipeline for this document.

tasks.description: Per-task elapsed seconds keyed by task name.
